{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches doc/bips.md and doc/release-notes-testnet5.md only to document the new testnet chain parameters.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Documentation updates are incidental to the implementation of Testnet 5."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds chain parameters for Testnet 5 in src/kernel/chainparams.cpp without changing the kernel API or architecture.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not modify the libbitcoinkernel interface, boundary, or usage as a library."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to src/policy/policy.cpp follow from moving rules into consensus verification under BIP 54.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Changes to policy files mechanically follow consensus cleanup rather than introducing separate mempool policy modifications."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/node/miner.cpp minimally to accommodate testnet chain rules.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter block template construction or the mining interface."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Exposes testnet5 in bitcoin-cli and test RPC assertions.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Updates to RPC utilities merely expose the new chain parameter configuration."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds extensive unit, functional, and fuzz tests specific to BIP 54 and Testnet 5 verification.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "The tests validate the new consensus and chain rules rather than test framework infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Registers the new chain type in src/util/chaintype.cpp and command-line parsing.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "General utility edits are purely boilerplate to register the testnet5 network identifier."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Implements BIP 95 chain parameters and BIP 54 consensus cleanup rules across src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp and src/validation.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Introduces Testnet 5 to eliminate the 20-minute minimum-difficulty rule exploited on earlier testnets and tests BIP 54 consensus cleanup rules from genesis."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touches test/functional/wallet_migration.py to accommodate chain parameters.",
      "band": "Unranked",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter any wallet functionality or interfaces."
    }
  ],

  }
